title: How P&G Develops Leaders From Day One
summary: Meaningful work, personalized growth and a supportive culture help every P&G employee reach their full potential.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


**How does P&G develop leaders?**


P&G grows leaders through a develop-from-within approach that combines meaningful responsibility, manager coaching, personalized development plans and intentional career experiences. Employees are given real business responsibility from Day One and are supported by leaders who are accountable for developing talent.


**What does “develop from within” meant at P&G?**


We are committed to developing our people, regardless of whether they joined through campus recruiting or as experienced hires. Through coaching, career planning and stretch assignments, employees build the experience and skills needed for increasing leadership responsibility. We also frequently place people into roles where they may not yet have every skill or experience required, giving them an opportunity to learn and grow. In many cases, that means choosing development opportunities for our people rather than hiring someone from the outside the Company.


**Does P&G provide leadership opportunities early in a career?**


Yes. At P&G, employees are placed in real jobs with real business impact from the start of their careers. Rather than spending months in training rotations, employees begin contributing immediately while learning through experience, coaching and development.


**How does P&G support employee growth and career development?**


P&G supports employee growth through ongoing coaching, career conversations, personalized development plans and intentionally designed job experiences. Managers are expected to act as coaches, helping employees build new skills, broaden their experience and prepare for future opportunities.


**What makes P&G’s employee experience unique?**


P&G strives to create an environment where every employee feels the company has been designed to help them be at their best. This philosophy is reflected in personalized growth plans, dedicated career conversations and development opportunities tailored to each employee's potential and aspirations.


**Why is P&G known for developing business leaders?**


P&G is known for its long-standing develop-from-within approach and commitment to talent development. The company's focus on meaningful work, coaching and increasing responsibility has helped employees grow into leadership roles throughout the organization.


**How does P&G help employees reach their full potential?**


P&G helps employees reach their full potential through meaningful work, manager coaching, personalized development plans and ongoing career conversations. The company intentionally provides opportunities for employees to learn, grow and take on new challenges throughout their careers.
